user.title: Add Middle Atlantic RackLink PDU
user.description: Select your RackLink PDU from the discovered devices, or enter connection details manually. {discovered_count} devices were found on your network.

connection_type.title: Choose connection method
connection_type.description: Select how to connect to your RackLink PDU. Redfish is modern and secure, Telnet supports legacy devices, and Auto tries Redfish first and falls back to Telnet.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Confirm RackLink device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found RackLink device at {hostname}. Enter the device credentials to continue.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate RackLink PDU
reauth_confirm.description: The PDU at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter valid credentials to continue.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure RackLink PDU
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your RackLink PDU.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Check the IP address and network connectivity, and make sure the control protocol is enabled on the device.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. The default username is often 'admin' with a device-specific password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.not_racklink_device: This device does not appear to be a RackLink PDU
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device at this address is a different PDU than the one originally configured

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PDU (5-300 seconds). Defaults: 10s for Redfish, 60s for Telnet.

outlet_non_critical.name: Outlet {outlet_number} powers off during load shedding

cycle_outlet.name: Cycle outlet
cycle_outlet.description: Cycles power for the targeted outlet switches.

cycle_all_outlets.name: Cycle all outlets
cycle_all_outlets.description: Cycles power for all outlets on the PDU that the targeted switch belongs to.

set_outlet_name.name: Set outlet name
set_outlet_name.description: Sets the label of the targeted outlet on the PDU.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name for the outlet.

set_pdu_name.name: Set PDU name
set_pdu_name.description: Sets the display name of the PDU that the targeted switch belongs to.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name for the PDU.
